messages:
ana: Quick sync — we need a compact, automatable sprint gate for enterprise compliance (audit exports, BYOK, KMS rotation, retention enforcement). Focus: CI-friendly pass/fail artifacts.

raj: Agreed. Keep it small so the gate is unblockable but legally defensible.

emma: Here's a tight checklist proposal (one-line tests):
```
- export_ndjson: sample export produced + sha256
- signed_manifest: manifest.json + manifest.sig (service-signer)
- append_only: checksum-chain verification script for 7d sample
- byok_cycle: handshake + export + restore on tenants {dev,staging,customer-sandbox}
- kms_rotate: rotate key -> verify decrypt on a shadow copy; manual-escrow verification documented
- retention_ttl: hot=30d,warm=365d,cold=3650d; enforcement smoke across 2 regions
- soc2_samples: 3 evidence packs with retrieval log entries
```

ops-checker-bot: Note: changing retention buckets requires a metadata backfill job; plan a short maintenance window during canary. Playbook: <https://internal.redwood/playbooks/retention-migration>.

legal-joe: Contract ask: notify customers for retention changes >90d beyond baseline with 30-day notice; escrow acceptance must include signed manifest and verifier logs. I'll draft text.

ana: [typo: should be ana] — who holds the manifest signing key?

raj: Ops will operate the signing service key (rotation-protected, auditable). Public verifier key published in docs.

emma: Action owners: raj -> signer + ops runbook; ana -> acceptance doc + CI harness; emma -> export/restore tool + checksum scripts; legal-joe -> contract snippet.

ops-checker-bot: Reminder: cross-region replication must honor TTLs; file infra ticket to validate replication retention enforcement.

emma: Example smoke curl for CI (will be added to smoke job):
```
curl -sS -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/v1/audit/export \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SMOKE_TOKEN" \ 
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \ 
  -d '{"tenant":"t-sandbox","from":"2026-03-01","to":"2026-03-07","format":"ndjson"}' \ 
  | tee export.ndjson && sha256sum export.ndjson > export.sha256 && ./sign-manifest --key /opt/signing/service.key export.sha256 > manifest.sig
```

raj: Timeline: 2-day spikes, then test runs across 3 tenants next week. PM will mark gate ready if all artifacts pass.

emma: I'll push a minimal acceptance doc to the repo and wire CI. Tagging stakeholders once logs are available. :white_check_mark:
